title: The Mark of Death
summary: Rank-A Captain Baek brands Ha-Jun with the Mark of Death, claiming his brother Tae-Jun slaughtered twenty-two hunters seven years ago. Overwhelmed by Baek's holy claymore and refusing to abandon Min-Jae, Ha-Jun's bloodline forcibly overclocks—unleashing an uncontrollable 25% demonic transformation.

panels.action: Ha-Jun kneels in the mud beside Min-Jae, channeling a gentle ring of violet mana into his bruised ribs to accelerate biological healing.
Min-Jae opens his eyes with difficulty, coughing weakly: 'H-Ha-Jun... wo Rank-A Captain hai... usse mat lado... bhaag jao...'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Wo Rank-A Captain hai... bhaag jao...

panels.action: Ha-Jun gently squeezes his friend's shoulder: 'Aaraam karo, Min-Jae. Tumne apna hissa poora kar diya.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Aaraam karo, Min-Jae. Main sambhaal lunga.

panels.action: Captain Baek approaches with heavy, unhurried strides, the tip of his holy claymore dragging through the wet turf and carving a smoking furrow.
Baek glances at the unconscious, broken body of Jun-Hyuk with utter disdain: 'Jun-Hyuk ne demonic serum lekar wardi ko daagdaar kiya. Par tum... tum paidaishi shaitan ho.'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain_baek
dialogue.text: Tum paidaishi shaitan ho, Kang Ha-Jun.

panels.shot: standing to face captain eye to eye
panels.action: Ha-Jun rises to his full height, staring straight into Baek's scarred eye: 'Main tumhara dushman nahi hoon. Main sirf ek student hoon jo apne dost ko bacha raha hai.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main sirf ek student hoon jo apne dost ko bacha raha hai.

panels.action: Baek laughs bitterly: 'Saat saal pehle tumhare bhai Tae-Jun ne bhi yahi kaha tha... isse pehle ki usne mere baees sathiyon ko zinda cheer diya.'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain_baek
dialogue.text: Saat saal pehle Tae-Jun ne mere 22 sathiyon ko maar daala tha!

panels.action: Extreme close-up on Ha-Jun's wide eyes: 'Bhaiya ne tumhare logo ko maara?! Jhooth! Wo sirf logo ko bachate the!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: JHOOTH! Bhaiya kisi begunah ko nahi maar sakte!

panels.action: Baek points the broad blade at Ha-Jun's chest: 'Demon blood ek abhishap hai. Jitne relics ko chhooge, utna hi insaani dimaag khatam hota jayega jab tak sirf darinda na bache.'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain_baek
dialogue.text: Relics tumhari insaaniyat ko nigal jaate hain.

panels.action: Baek unleashes his Class-A holy aura: Two radiant golden light wings erupt from his shoulder blades, blinding the surrounding yard.
Flashing blood-red system prompt: [EXTREME THREAT: RANK-A HOLY PALADIN] | [POWER DISPARITY: 4.8X] | [RECOMMENDED: RETREAT TO SUBTERRANEAN VOID].

panels.shot: refusal to retreat glance at friend
panels.action: Ha-Jun glances back at unconscious Min-Jae in the mud: 'Main peeche nahi hat sakta. Mera dost peeche hai.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Agar main bhaaga... toh yeh Min-Jae ko maar dega.

panels.action: Baek raises his gauntleted hand: 'Bureau ke aadesh se... main tumhe Mark of Death se daagta hoon.'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain_baek
dialogue.text: Mark of Death! Maut ka nishaan sweekar karo!

panels.action: A flying branding seal of burning golden holy runes shoots across the air like a tracer bullet aimed at Ha-Jun's brow.
Ha-Jun swings his crystalline demonic gauntlet outward to swat the flying golden seal out of the sky.

panels.shot: brand burning into crystalline gauntlet macro
panels.action: The golden holy seal impacts the purple crystal gauntlet and violently burns into the armor, searing a glowing execution cross into the rock.
The Mark of Death restricts Ha-Jun's demonic mana flow; veins in his right arm turn ashen gray in agonizing holy rejection.
Baek closes the gap instantaneously, his massive golden claymore descending in a vertical executioner cleave: 'Holy Severance!'
Ha-Jun dives sideways; the golden blade cleaves a 40-foot deep trench through the turf, felling two mature oak trees in explosions of wood.
Rolling across the mud, Ha-Jun channels the Ring of Hollow Blood: A spinning four-bladed crystalline blood shuriken forms and whips toward Baek.

panels.shot: claymore baseball bat swat shatters blood
panels.action: Baek casually swats the blood shuriken with the flat of his massive blade, shattering the crimson construct into harmless red droplets.

panels.shot: heavy armored elbow strike to solar plexus
panels.action: Baek flash-steps directly inside Ha-Jun's reach, driving a heavy steel-reinforced elbow strike directly into Ha-Jun's solar plexus.
The concussive blow blasts the air from Ha-Jun's lungs, hurling his body 30 feet into the brick wall of the auditorium.
Bricks and mortar collapse over Ha-Jun as he slides down into the rubble, coughing a heavy spray of scarlet blood onto the muddy grass.
Baek walks forward with calm, rhythmic executioner steps, lifting his claymore with both hands: 'Apni maut ko shanti se qubool karo.'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain_baek
dialogue.text: Maut ko shanti se qubool karo.

panels.shot: staring at blood on trembling palms macro
panels.action: In the rubble, Ha-Jun stares down at his own scarlet blood pooling in his trembling palms, thoughts echoing with his brother's voice.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Kya main phir se kamzor pad gaya...?

panels.action: Kuro shrieks from above: 'HA-JUN! BLOODLINE KO OVERCLOCK KARO! WARNA WO TUMHARI GARDAN KAAT DEGA!!'
Deep within Ha-Jun's soul, an ancient gargantuan obsidian chain snaps with a thunderous void echo: *SNAP-CRACK!!*
System UI flashes dark crimson and black: [EMERGENCY: BLOOD OVERCLOCK] | [SYNCHRONIZATION SURGING: 15% -> 25%] | [WARNING: MENTAL REASON COMPROMISED].

panels.shot: black-violet hellfire eruption demonic horns cliffhanger
panels.action: Ha-Jun rises from the rubble: Colossal pillars of black-violet hellfire tear through the clouds, and two razor-sharp obsidian demon horns sprout through his hair: 'Tumne mere bhai ko... monster kaise kaha?!'
panels.mood: birth of the demon sovereign, ultimate cliffhanger

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: TUMNE MERE BHAI KO MONSTER KAISE KAHA?!!
